item.title: Projects
item.description: Here’s a list of the small and not-so-small things I’ve built or explored during my self-taught journey into IT. Some are finished, some abandoned, all are part of the process. 🎮 2D Space Invaders Game (Python + Pygame) A basic arcade shooter clone with working collision detection, shooting mechanics, and alien logic.
